page.notes: Printed page number "251" at the head is uncertain in its last digit. Margin note "Morbi causa..." is a five-line note; its last word "prospiciatur" is uncertain in the first syllable. "ut sic hanc" is uncertain: the word after "ut" is blotted. "fuc-rit" at the line end may be a printing error for "fuerit", left as printed. "Cauea" and "follicitudinis" are read as printed but not fully certain. Text ends mid-word at "publi-" as printed; no catchword or signature is visible.
